title: Component structure layer audit and publish checklist
creator: Asha Kapoor
description: Conduct a full audit of component layer structure and auto-layout constraints across the Figma library. Primary goals are to: reduce variant explosion by consolidating similar states, flatten unnecessary nested frames to improve copy/replace reliability, standardize naming patterns across tokens and components, fix inconsistent auto-layout constraints that cause size jitter, and produce a reproducible publish checklist and rollback plan for library releases.
comments: 2026-02-18 — Asha Kapoor: Created ticket after initial spike revealed ~18 components with inconsistent auto-layout settings and ~32 token mismatches across button/table/chart families. Recommended first pass: variant dedupe + layer flattening for low-risk components.

2026-02-22 — Riley Ortiz: Scoped work into two phases: Phase 1 (audit + low-risk fixes) and Phase 2 (naming refactor + publish checklist + QA). Assigned Phase 1 to design ops; raised dependency on ENG-3021 for build-token mapping script.

2026-02-28 — Riley Ortiz: Completed audit spreadsheet (linked) and marked 12 components as low-risk for immediate cleanup. Decision: convert mixed 'Fill/Auto' width buttons to explicit auto-width tokens where possible to avoid ripple changes in product UX.

2026-03-03 — Miles Chen (Design Systems): Proposed variant consolidation rules: 1) merge visually identical variants that differ only by hidden layers, 2) prefer boolean property variants over duplicate frames, 3) ensure all interactive states use the same naming suffixes (-default, -hover, -active, -disabled). Feedback requested from PMs on label changes affecting docs.

2026-03-06 — Riley Ortiz: Implemented automated rename script for 18 token keys in the draft file. Ran smoke tests in staging with the token-mapping tool; two chart color tokens required manual verification due to legacy aliases.

2026-03-09 — Design Review: Reviewed 9 low-risk component PRs. Approval given for buttons and small table components. Blocker identified for the main table header component — requires alignment with ENG-3021 change to CSS variables mapping.

2026-03-11 — Riley Ortiz: Drafted publish checklist and rollback steps. Checklist items: run token mapping, run lint script, smoke test product screens using snapshot plugin, tag release Figma library, update release notes, schedule canary release. Next: schedule canary and pair with frontend to validate runtime consumption.
2026-03-11 — QA Notes: Added test matrix for button size/label truncation, table column reflow scenarios, and chart legend spacing. QA expected to complete by 2026-03-18 before full publish.
